hints.title: Constraint Scale
hints.text: Since n <= 50 and limit <= 50, closed-form stars and bars or dual iteration both pass easily.

hints.title: Inclusion-Exclusion Closed Form
hints.text: The number of non-negative solutions to a + b + c = n with each variable <= limit is given by inclusion-exclusion.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping works for small n, but closed-form formula runs in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion or clean double iteration.
